clips.title: The story
paras: Near Malaka'jin, Darn Talongrip watches the Stonetalon frontier. The orc scout tracks threats in the crags and carries word between forward outposts and Horde commanders.

Darn Talongrip watches the rugged climbs into Stonetalon from the southern Barrens. At Malaka'jin, he directs recruits toward the Horde's new fronts in Ashenvale. Travelers climbing into the contested peaks can reach the Horde through his post.

From Malaka'jin, Darn sends messages and reports from the front to commanders such as Kadrak, at the watch tower in the northern Barrens. Encampments scattered through the mountains face constant pressure, and Darn keeps the Horde vanguard informed as a sentry and courier.
